chunks: about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration."
He said: "It is staying awake in salat (prayer)."

key_terms.وُجُوهِهِمْ: their faces, where the sign is described as appearing

ai.seo_question: What does "their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration" mean in Qur'an 48:29?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about the believers' mark from sajdah as referring to wakefulness and exertion in salat (prayer), especially night worship. The emphasis is on devotional striving rather than a physical mark, highlighting the spiritual effect of sustained worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1366 - Abdullah ibn Sinan asked him (Abu Abdullah (as))
about the words of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:
"Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration" (Surah Al-Fath 48:29).
Imam (as) said: "It refers to staying awake for prayer."
